definition: used to say the same thing more simply
description: A small car repair garage with a brick wall. An old cream car is raised on a lift with one wheel removed. A young woman mechanic in a navy top and rust-coloured overalls tied at the waist holds up a worn car part next to her phone and patiently explains it to a young man in a cream knitted sweater and black trousers. He scratches his head with a wide-eyed, confused look, then his face opens into a smile as she lowers the phone. A red tool chest, oil cans and a stack of tyres fill the garage.

taps.phrase: to hold up a worn part
